- agents.md (stable log prefixes section)
  Line or code reference: the `LOG_PREFIX.name=...` machine-readable list at the end of the "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" section
  Problem: The PR introduces four new contractual log prefixes (`SECURITY_PASS_AUTO_RESET`, `SECURITY_PASS_AUTO_RESET_SKIPPED`, `STAGED_SUPPORT_LATCH_RELEASED`, `STAGED_SUPPORT_LATCH_RELEASED_SKIPPED`) — the README/agents.md prose and the new tests treat them as stable grep targets — but they are not registered in the `LOG_PREFIX.name=` list that the agents.md section declares is what workflow-log-analysis and API-hygiene reporting depend on. The existing `SECURITY_PASS_*` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_LATCH_*` siblings (e.g. `SECURITY_PASS_CLEAN`, `STAGED_SUPPORT_LATCH_RELEASED` peers) are registered there.
  Why it fails at runtime: workflow-log-analysis tooling that keys off the contractual prefix list will not classify or report occurrences of the new markers, so the new auto-reset / latch-release behavior is invisible to the periodic audit reports that consume this list.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3

- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS:
  File: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  Location: auto-reset state write (lines 17369-17386)
  Issue: if the `jq` state rewrite fails, the `&&` short-circuits the `mv` but execution continues into `reconcile_tracking_body_after_security_pass_transition`, `set_tracking_phase_label "ai:security-pass"`, the reset comment, and `ensure_security_pass_before_completion` with the state file still saying `failed` — a half-reset where the label and comment claim a reset the state never recorded.
  Suggested minimal fix: guard the post-reset steps on the jq success, e.g. `if jq ... > "${STATE_FILE}.tmp" && mv ...; then <reconcile/label/comment/audit/continue> else echo "::warning::security-pass auto-reset state write failed; retrying next tick"; fi` (~4 lines changed).
  Estimated lines changed: 4
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
